requirement.description: The async_option builder incorrectly rejects async generators when it should support them. Tests are failing because the builder throws TypeError when encountering async generators, but the tests expect to use async generators with the sync builder.
requirement.contract: The async_option builder should support async generators when properly decorated with @effect.async_option, and should properly handle the async generator execution flow instead of throwing an error.

requirement.description: The async_result builder incorrectly rejects async generators when it should support them. Tests are failing because the builder throws TypeError when encountering async generators, but the tests expect to use async generators with the sync builder.
requirement.contract: The async_result builder should support async generators when properly decorated with @effect.async_result, and should properly handle the async generator execution flow instead of throwing an error.

requirement.description: The seq builder fails when trying to process list iterators returned from Seq.empty(). The error AttributeError: 'list_iterator' object has no attribute 'send' indicates that the builder doesn't properly handle non-generator iterables like list iterators.
requirement.contract: The seq builder should properly handle list iterators and other non-generator iterables by converting them to proper generators before processing.

requirement.description: The option builder has a test failure where test_option_builder_nested fails with "missing 1 required positional argument: 'x'", indicating that the decorator isn't correctly passing arguments to nested functions.
requirement.contract: The option builder should correctly pass arguments to nested functions when using the @effect.option decorator.

requirement.description: The result builder has a test failure where test_result_builder_yield_value_async fails with "assert None == 42", suggesting that the generator's final value is not being properly extracted.
requirement.contract: The result builder should properly extract the final yielded value from generators when they complete.
